title: Legion of Super-Heroes #269 DC 1980 Fatal Five Return Validus vs Mon-El
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. Small handwritten "C-423" at the lower left of the front cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Legion of Super-Heroes #269 (November 1980), DC Comics - they're back! The fearsome Fatal Five, and who is their new leader? Validus vs. Mon-El in the first battle of the new galactic war. Dick Giordano cover. 50 cent cover price.

Back cover: Daisy 840 BB gun ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. Small handwritten "C-423" at the lower left of the front cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
